name: fig27_page_curves_dimensions
caption: Haar-average entropy of the first k of N qubits from Page's exact formula <S_{m,n}> = psi(mn+1) - psi(n+1) - (m-1)/(2n). The normalised curves approach the piecewise-linear bound min(k, N-k)/N as N grows (the rise-then-fall shape comes from sampling pure states of a fixed total dimension, not from an imposed curve). At the symmetric point the average falls short of the maximal value (N/2) ln 2 by 1/2 nat in the large-N limit (b).
